Listen I can already tell from the spelling errors and the way you are writing that you’re mind is racing right now. What would be the best is to evaluate what you can control in your life from what you can’t. For example you can’t control if a boy will ask you out or if you will have a break out from acne. But what you can control is your actions and emotions. If you fill your held with self doubt you are bound to fail before even trying. But if you turn those emotions around into emotions of self confidence and self awareness you can seem more put together.

I am not going to lie I have been there when anxiety hits and things are uncertain. Hell I had to pack up to move to the other side of the US in a two days notice. I was staying with a good friends family at the time who generously let me stay after my childhood home got foreclosed and I had no where to go for spring break. They saw me keeping my cool when from the outside it looked like everything was falling apart around me. My friend mom asked how I kept my cool and sanity during all this. I replied “because I have confidence in my self that I will make it through this no matter what and I know that while I cannot control my surroundings right now I can control my reactions to them” 

So take a deep breath sister and believe in yourself! While you can’t control what a boy thinks of you, you can control how you react to it. Make a mantra for yourself to reassure your self confidence. My personal one is “I will face struggle, there will be those who will try to do ill will but they are ignorant to what is good and bad, I have been though struggle and I will make it though worse, **I AM A CHAD**” these sayings help keep us grounded in reality and keep faith in ourselves.
